text: FANTASTEEL is POSCO's advertising campaign; Posco produced it with Nexon in celebration of the 50th anniversary of its first steel mill, and it won the Grand Prix at the 2023 Korea Digital Advertising Festival.

source.name: The Korea Herald: Posco's 'Fantasteel' ad campaign nabs awards
source.quote: In celebration, the company joined hands with gaming giant Nexon to produce the "Fantasteel" campaign
